organization_note: Google DeepMind develops the models. Google LLC, of Mountain View and the largest of Alphabet Inc.'s companies, offers the Gemini API, the Gemini apps, and the developer tools, while Google Cloud operates Vertex AI and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. The catalog names the developer Google for most releases and Google DeepMind for one, and names the Vertex AI operator Google Cloud, so all three names belong to this record.
